svg.title: Square-bore flute in A4, box-rect-3, sheet 1 of 1
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. Square-bore flute in A4, box-rect-3, sheet 1 of 1: bird layer, bottom plate, mouthpiece cap, plug disc, side wall, top plate. 3mm ply, drawn for a 0.13mm kerf. Finger joints as the trumpet bores cut them: 6mm fingers and spaces, no play, the fit from the kerf. Blue #0000ff engraves (the part numbers; the flue as a fill engrave about 1mm deep; and the depression round each finger hole, a greyscale image engrave, Grayscale mode in xTool Creative Space -- set both depths on scrap first), orange #ff8000 cuts the holes and slots, black #000000 frees the parts.
